items.title: China's central offices issue guidance on deepening the integration of technological and industrial innovation
items.summary: On 21 October the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council released the guidance, which takes developing new quality productive forces and building a modern industrial system as its goals, focuses on an enterprise-led innovation system with coordinated participants across industry, academia and research, and calls for end-to-end, full-domain, all-factor and all-round support so that technological and industrial innovation reinforce each other.
